name: dev.tinify/mcp
description: Compress, resize, crop, and convert images with the Tinify.dev API from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: TINIFY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tinify.dev API key (tnf_live_* or tnf_test_*), created at https://tinify.dev/developers. Free tier: 500 operations/month.

environmentVariables.name: TINIFY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API origin (advanced; defaults to https://api.tinify.dev).
